title: EDU-Jev Training System-One Decision Models for Education
abstract: arXiv:2610.41079v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many automated decisions in education involve choosing from a fixed set of options: assigning a rubric score, checking whether an answer meets a marking criterion, or identifying the first wrong step in a solution. Generative language models are increasingly used to make these decisions, but their responses require parsing, longer outputs increase inference costs, and confidence expressed in words does not necessarily reflect the probability of being correct. We present EDU-Jev, a family of single-pass ("System One") decision models at 0.8B, 2B and 4B parameters. Given an assessment context and a question with predefined answer options, the model returns a probability distribution over those options without generating text. A pointer head scores a marker for each option, ensuring the predictions are restricted to the allowed choices. translated_title: EDU-Jev 训练系统——面向教育的“系统一”决策模型
translated_abstract: 教育领域的许多自动化决策都涉及从固定的选项集合中进行选择，例如评定量规分数、判断某个答案是否满足评分标准，或找出解题过程中第一个出错的步骤。生成式语言模型正越来越多地被用于做出这类决策，但其响应需要解析，更长的输出会增加推理成本，而且用文字表达的置信度并不一定反映真实的正确概率。我们提出了 EDU-Jev，这是一系列参数规模为 0.8B、2B 和 4B 的单次前向（“系统一”）决策模型。给定一个评估情境和一道带有预定义答案选项的题目，模型直接返回这些选项上的概率分布，而无需生成文本。一个指针头为每个选项对应的标记打分，确保预测被限制在允许的选项范围内。训练采用单一监督阶段，使用软交叉熵损失针对可用的目标标签分布进行优化。
tldr: 该论文提出 EDU-Jev 系列面向教育评估任务的单次前向决策模型（0.8B/2B/4B 参数），通过指针头直接输出预定义选项上的概率分布而无需生成文本，实现了更快、更省、更可靠的教育自动化决策。
en_tdlr: This paper presents EDU-Jev, a family of single-pass "System One" decision models (0.8B/2B/4B) for education that use a pointer head to directly output a probability distribution over predefined answer options without generating text, enabling faster, cheaper, and more reliable automated educational decisions.
